groups.title: Letters, points and sound
groups.blurb: Everything before the grammar: which letter is which, what each sign says, and where the stress falls.

groups.title: Gender agreement
groups.blurb: Hebrew makes you state a gender in four places at once. This is all four, mixed together.

groups.title: The little words
groups.blurb: One-letter prefixes, the object marker and the verb Hebrew does not have. Individually trivial, collectively most of a sentence.

groups.title: The present tense
groups.blurb: Four forms per verb, three more binyanim, and the one letter that gives each of them away.

groups.title: Putting two nouns together
groups.blurb: Smikhut, the article, the adjective and שֶׁל: four ways of joining things, and which one each situation wants.

groups.title: Past, present and future
groups.blurb: The whole tense system in one sitting, across every binyan the course has taught.

groups.title: The seven binyanim
groups.blurb: One root, seven moulds. Recognising which one a verb is in, and what that does to its meaning.

groups.title: Joining two clauses
groups.blurb: שֶׁ, and everything built on it: relatives, reported speech, cause, purpose, time and contrast.

groups.title: Being done to
groups.blurb: נִפְעַל, פּוּעַל and הוּפְעַל, and why speech avoids two of the three.

groups.title: The ones that stay confusing
groups.blurb: לָמָּה against מַדּוּעַ, אִם against עִם, אֲבָל against אֶלָּא, and the rest of the list that never quite settles.
